verdict.rationale: Asana documents its own AI automation features: AI Studio for no-code automations and pre-built or custom AI Teammates that work inside real workflows. This plausibly covers AI-driven intake handling, but no evidence describes triaging or prioritizing incoming bugs or tasks. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of AI triage/prioritization of incoming work items, details of how AI Studio rules classify or rank requests, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have AI automatically triage and prioritize incoming bugs and tasks

citations.quote: Pre-built AI agents that work alongside your team inside real workflows, with shared memory, governance, and context from the Work Graph
custom AI Teammates built to handle the complex, coordination-heavy work that slows your team down
